meta.title: Basic 1000 bootstrap course

teach_modes.picture: shown with an image; no text definition
teach_modes.action: shown with a movement or short video; no text definition
teach_modes.demo: grammar or function word, taught through its examples; no text definition
teach_modes.definition: explained with a Basic English definition

rules: Every definition uses only words from earlier steps.
Every word has at least one teaching example that uses only words from earlier steps or the same step.
Other examples are review examples, usable from available_from_step onward.
Free forms count as the base word: -s/-es, -ed, -ing, -er, -est, -ly, un-, irregular forms, grouped pronoun forms, and the listed free compounds (someone, something, cannot ...).
